thread:
alex: Hey — anyone know where the KV/prefix cache hit-rate dashboard lives for prod? We saw a drop from ~96% to ~78% around 09:12 UTC and a couple of user-facing latencies spiked. Trying to triage before paging.

maria: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/kv-cache/kv-cache-overview?orgId=1&var-env=prod — look at panels 'Prefix cache hit rate' and 'prefix cache miss latency'.

sam: The PromQL we use for the panel: `sum by(model) (increase(kv_prefix_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum by(model) (increase(kv_prefix_cache_requests_total[5m])) * 100` — you can change the window to [1m] if you need higher granularity.

jess: Also check logs for cache eviction churn. Kibana query: `service:inference AND env:prod AND message:"kv-cache" AND level:warn` Link: https://kibana.redwood.ai/app/kibana#/discover?_a=(...)

alex: Thanks — ran the PromQL and confirmed hit-rate dip for model 'redwood-13b' at ~09:12. Any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: deploy completed by @sam at 2025-11-09T09:05:33Z — rollout: inference/redwood-13b v1.4.2 -> v1.4.3

maria: That matches. v1.4.3 changed key construction for streaming responses, likely introduced more distinct prefixes. Could explain lower hit-rate.

sam: Yep — accidentally added request-id to prefix key for transient requests. I'm opening a PR to revert. In the meantime we could widen alert thresholds or add a short suppression window.

jess: Current alert is `KVCacheLowHitRate` firing when 5m_avg < 85% for 10m. Maybe tune to 75% for prod during rollouts, or add `for: 20m` to reduce noise.

maria: I'd rather suppress for a specific service tag during the rollouts. I'll add a mute rule for `inference:redwood-13b` for the next 30m and reboot the alert if still low.

alex: Could we also trace a sample request? Where do we find spans for cache miss path?

sam: Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/search?service=inference — click `kv_cache_miss` span name and filter by trace tags `model=redwood-13b`. Use the trace UI to see if misses correlate with disk/cache thrash.

maria: Also check node metrics: `node_memory_.*` and `nvmemcache_evictions_total`. If evictions spike that points to size/pressure.

alex: Quick note — here's a sample log showing the new prefix format (sensitive bits redacted):
```
WARN kv-cache: miss key=stream:rqid:abc123:model=redwood-13b prefix_len=42
```

sam: I'll revert the prefix change in PR #3425 and include a test to avoid adding ephemeral ids to keys. Assigning to @jess for review.

jess: I'll take it. Also suggest adding a synthetic check that asserts hit-rate >= 90% on canary traffic in CI.

maria: For immediate ops: mute alert for inference:redwood-13b for 30m (done) — alert should clear but leave note in incident channel if not.

alex: Thanks all. If PR lands and rollout done, I'll re-run the PromQL and confirm. Leaving it async.

monitoring-bot: Reminder: Created mute rule `mute-inference-redwood-13b-1754827200` by maria, expires in 30m.

sam: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/3425 — description: revert prefix change, add unit test.

alex: ping @jess for review when you have a minute.

jess: Reviewing now, ETA 30m.
